devon-price.description: A towering flat-top makes his head look like a nightclub doorway.
An absurdly broad bartender jacket narrows to a tiny waist.

elise-moreau.description: A question-mark forelock curls above her head.
An oversized shoulder recorder hangs beside her narrow coat.

generic-resident.description: Two broad square lenses look like apartment windows.
A long scarf drops down one side of the body.

linda.description: A cloud-sized side hair mass is almost as large as her torso.
A flared dress widens below her cloud-sized hair.

linda-boyfriend.description: A tiny perfect pompadour perches on an unusually long head.
A nervous bow tie is almost as wide as his shoulders.

mina-park.description: Her bun rises in three rounded layers like stacked spa stones.
One towel sleeve is much larger than the other and a small supply bag hangs at her hip.

priya-nair.description: Two long hair sticks cross through a high bun like antennae.
Her clinic coat has two oversized square pockets.

protagonist.description: An enormous wind-swept prizewinner forelock points forward like a wave.
A large diagonal luggage strap makes the accidental tourist silhouette.

rafael-cruz.description: A broad moustache curls upward beyond both cheeks.
A cook apron and long ladle sit across his round build.

resident-01.description: A tiny wearable umbrella spreads wider than the shoulders.
A wide rain cape completes the shape.

resident-02.description: Two round buns orbit the head like small planets.
Two large black boots anchor the tiny body.

resident-03.description: A crescent cap leans far past one side of the head.
A short square tunic uses one bright cuff.

resident-04.description: A giant satchel hangs from shoulder to ankle.
A rigid guitar case rises behind the free shoulder.

resident-05.description: A lantern-shaped chin extends below a tiny mouth.
A short jacket makes the head look even longer.

resident-06.description: A flat straw hat spans almost the full sprite.
Two short braids hang below the brim.

resident-07.description: A coin-sized hat sits above a collar that covers both cheeks.
The coat widens toward the feet.

resident-08.description: One bell sleeve is wider than the torso while the other arm is bare.
A short ponytail points the opposite way.

resident-09.description: A giant bow is wider than the head.
Two large black boots make the tiny body look grounded.

resident-10.description: A soft beanie rises in a tall crooked tower.
A very long scarf falls down the back.

resident-11.description: Hair opens into a stiff fan on one side only.
A broad split tunic balances the opposite side.

resident-12.description: A spiral moustache ends in two square curls.
A round vest uses one tiny central button.

resident-13.description: An oversized monocle chain loops from eye to waist.
The jacket closes on one side only.

resident-14.description: Two pale collar wings rise above the shoulders.
A tiny waist belt sits under the wide upper body.

resident-15.description: A rigid loop backpack arches above the head.
A loose charm bracelet hangs from one wrist.

resident-16.description: Two giant square gloves hang beside a tiny torso.
Two large black boots mirror the heavy gloves.

resident-17.description: A cap has one tall ear flap and one missing flap.
A half cape falls from the uncovered side.

resident-18.description: A tall soft mohawk bends over like a tired plant.
A wide shirt carries two narrow suspenders.

resident-19.description: A tiny cap trails a stiff square veil behind the head.
A pearl necklace loops below the veil.

resident-20.description: Two blocky star glasses cover most of the face.
A narrow shirt has one star-shaped cuff.

resident-21.description: A square tropical bird sits permanently on one shoulder.
A large necklace fills the front of the coat.

resident-22.description: Three stiff braids form a small tripod around the head.
A tall guitar case hangs behind the plain coat.

resident-23.description: Two stacked pairs of square goggles cover most of the face.
A broad short jacket makes the long head look even taller.

resident-24.description: Two spiral shell shoulder pieces make a wide sea-creature silhouette.
A thin ponytail drops between the shells.

sora-tan.description: An enormous angular fashion collar points past both shoulders.
One sleeve reaches the wrist while the other stops high on the arm.

tomas-reed.description: Square ear defenders are wider than his head.
A long narrow clerk body carries a rigid permit pouch.
